newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI CHLOR-ALKALI HALF-YR NET DOWN.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI CHLOR-ALKALI HALF-YR NET DOWN.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures)
Net asset per share 3.11 yuan vs 2.99 yuan
Earnings per share 0.116 yuan vs 0.126 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co Ltd.

Note: The results were contained in a company statement published by the Shanghai stock exchange on Thursday. The figures are unaudited as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited. Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on Friday morning, the statement said. --Shanghai Newsroom (8621) 6279-7004
